newsitem.title: USA: Kodak, Wang in talks about software.
newsitem.headline: Kodak, Wang in talks about software.

text.p: Wang Laboratories and Eastman Kodak Co said on Thursday they were discussing a possible transaction involving Wang's software business.

The companies said in a statement all talks were ongoing and it would be premature to provide additional comments at this time. In 1995, Kodak's Business Imaging Systems unit entered into a strategic alliance with Wang to jointly develop and market a set of common document imaging architectures.
These products were the foundation for Kodak Business Imaging Systems software solutions, which integrated imaging into existing applications on all common server platforms.
The companies were not immediately available for further comment about the possible sale of Wang's imaging software business.
